section.title: Specialized Endodontic Services
section.description: Focused care for complex root and pulp needs, delivered with precision and a patient-first approach.

services.title: Apexogenesis
services.description: Apexogenesis is a vital pulp therapy procedure that encourages continued physiologic root-end development in immature teeth.

services.title: Revascularization
services.description: Revascularization is a regenerative endodontic method that promotes vital tissue growth to replace necrotic pulp tissue, most often in open-apex teeth.

services.title: Post Removal
services.description: Post removal is a procedure to remove a custom or preformed rod cemented into the root canal of an endodontically treated tooth, providing core retention.

services.title: Silver Point Removal
services.description: Silver point removal addresses an older obturation method that used rigid, radiopaque silver cones sized to root canal files and placed with a sealer.

services.title: Separated Instrument Removal
services.description: Separated instrument removal retrieves broken endodontic instruments from narrow, complex canals by using specialized techniques.

services.title: Perforation Repair
services.description: Perforation repair treats a communication between the root canal system and the external tooth surface caused by pathological or mechanical factors and seals it to prevent leakage and reinfection.
